description: This Java source file defines the SensorGauge class, which provides UI components for displaying sensor data as gauges, including creating gauges, handling user interactions such as double clicks and right-click context menus, and managing updates from sensor data.

classes.name: SensorGauge
classes.description: Class providing static methods to create and manage gauge UI components for sensors, including event handling and context menus.

classes.name: SensorGauge.GaugeChangeListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to changes in sensor gauge configurations.

methods.name: SensorGauge.createGauge
methods.description: Creates a gauge component wrapped in a panel with event listeners.

methods.name: SensorGauge.createGaugeBody
methods.description: Constructs the main gauge UI element and sets up sensor update listener and user interaction handlers.

methods.name: SensorGauge.showPopupMenu
methods.description: Displays a right-click context menu with sensor options.

methods.name: SensorGauge.fillGaugeMenuItems
methods.description: Populates the context menu with sensor category and sensor items.

methods.name: SensorGauge.handleDoubleClick
methods.description: Handles double-click events on gauges to detach them into separate windows.

methods.name: SensorGauge.createRadial
methods.description: Creates and configures a Radial gauge with specified labels and value ranges.
